metadata.title: Memory chips have come to rule the AI boom. Why Micron’s reign could be here to stay. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Tech Stocks
Memory chips have come to rule the AI boom. Why Micron’s reign could be here to stay.
Semiconductor-industry revenue is expected to reach $1.5 trillion this year, driven mostly by memory chips
Memory has become the “king” of the semiconductor industry, according to one analyst, and he believes “its reign is here to stay.”
Investments into artificial-intelligence data centers have put chip-industry revenue on pace to double to $1.5 trillion this year, and memory chips have been ”the primary driver” of that jump, Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini said, citing data from the Semiconductor Industry Association on global shipments and average sales prices in July.
